terms.meaning: Scalable Vector Graphics, a drawing format made of shapes, so it stays sharp at any size.
A simple picture that stands for an idea, like a padlock for a locked call.
A setting that hides an element from screen readers because it adds no information on its own.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports
sections.what: Imports the type for content that can be placed inside a component.
sections.why: Needed so the drawings can be typed.

sections.name: line, UiPictogramKey
sections.title: Shared line style and icon names
sections.what: Sets one drawing style for all icons, with a fixed line thickness, rounded ends and no fill. Lists the six icon names allowed.
sections.why: Keeps the icons consistent and stops callers from inventing names.
sections.watch_out: Adding a name here without a drawing in the next section leaves the icon blank.

sections.name: SHAPES
sections.title: Icon drawings
sections.what: Holds the drawing for each icon: a fork for decide, a padlock for lock, a target for grade, a torn slip for receipt, three heads for crew, and two speech panels for language.
sections.why: Each drawing matches the idea it stands for, and the comments explain each choice.
sections.watch_out: Every name needs a drawing, and a missing one renders silently empty.

sections.name: UiPictogram
sections.title: Icon component
sections.what: Draws the chosen icon as a square image, hidden from screen readers, and stores the icon name on the image for tests or styling.
sections.why: Icons are decoration, so they are hidden from assistive tools.
sections.watch_out: Because screen readers skip it, any meaning must come from nearby text.

summary: Draws the six small icons the interface uses for decisions, locks, grading, receipts, crews and language.
purpose: Gives the interface a consistent set of decorative icons.
why: Icons share one drawing style so they match the sport pictograms in look.
how: Holds one shared line style, a list of six icon names, and a drawing for each name. The component draws the chosen icon inside a square image.
inputs: An icon name from the list, and an optional class name for styling.
outputs: A square image element with the drawing inside, marked as decorative.
risks: A name without a drawing renders an empty icon with no error. The icons are hidden from screen readers, so they must not carry meaning alone.
debug: If an icon is blank, check that its name has a drawing in the shape list. If it looks wrong, check the shared line style.
